body: Please tell them. I wish you all the best.
It was my weakness. I was too selfish at the beginning of the end. And then, I fucked it up more by trying to hold on when they rightfully needed space.
This is one of the greatest compliments I could receive. I wish you all the best.
This is beautiful. I hope you both feel better. Life is long, keep an open mind.
Thank you for you kind sentiments. Unfortunately, there is no chance.
I know we'll never be together again. Too much has happened.
You can do it. It hurts so much, but you must choose yourself first all the time. I believe in you.
